common.style_usage: the Stardew Valley pixel art style and colours of Tobin's pottery: warm brick and wood ramps, dark coloured (never black) outlines, clean flat shading

wheel.reference_usage: this potter's kick wheel, its parts and colours: draw it the same but wider and bigger, filling the picture
wheel.description: Stardew Valley pixel art, one object alone on a transparent background, seen straight from the front at eye level, close up, very wide and perfectly symmetrical, filling the whole picture from side to side: a potter's kick wheel. A flat round grey metal wheel head on top, seen edge-on as a thin wide disc, with nothing on it; a very wide shallow round wooden splash pan around it; a sturdy wooden frame with two legs; a heavy round wooden kick wheel low down between the legs. Warm wood, dark coloured (not black) outlines.
